verdict.rationale: Glama hosts MCP servers and automatically fronts them with a Gateway endpoint ('Deploy any server from the registry to Glama and we automatically put the Gateway in front of it... No proxy setup, no manual wiring – the endpoint you get is the Gateway'), and each server page provides pre-filled config blocks for popular clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code) to point at that URL, meaning a developer can connect without deploying infra themselves. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the remote-URL connection actually working end-to-end, and more detail on reliability/uptime of hosted endpoints beyond docs claims.
